org: Morningstar Design System – Charts / Chart Elements
accessNotes: The legacy designsystem.morningstar.com/charts/* pages embed chart docs via iframes (chart-docs/<page>/2.0.1/) that now return S3 AccessDenied; the site redirects to the new design.morningstar.com 'Data Visualization' system, whose element pages are client-rendered. Read: colour tokens table (rendered chart-elements-docs/color-vue3/2.0.5 iframe in a browser), CSS embedded in the x-axis/y-axis/legend/guidelines Vue 3 build.js bundles, and server-rendered common-chart pages (bar vertical, line, donut, accessibility). Grid, layout, hover-flag and x/y-axis guideline prose were not accessible (403/JS-only); structure inferred from official anatomy images.
summary: Financial product-UI chart system (Vue 'Chart Elements') with strong semantic colour meanings (asset classes, performance, sectors, valuation). Distinctive Swiss-like look in the light-weight MorningstarIntrinsic typeface: y-axis tick labels hang right-aligned beneath short black rule segments in a separate label column, dotted light-grey gridlines, black top and bottom rules, legend in a right-hand column under a rule, 3px white gaps between adjacent plots.

colors.categoricalNotes: 'Generic' palette: 'Always use the generic colors in their provided order, which has been tested across different color weaknesses.' Use semantic palettes when the data has meaning: Asset Allocation — Equity #2364B9, Fixed Income #F47206, Alternative #B2013C, Cash #039649, Other #F5C72C, Not Classified #ECEBEA; Super Sectors — Cyclical #F47206, Sensitive #2364B9, Defensive #039649 (sub-sectors inherit); Valuation — Under #00A8E1, Fair #E5E5E5, Over #EF7622; Correlation — positive #2364B9, negative #F47206; ESG rating #2364B9. Accessibility guide: if you need more than four or five colours, simplify into multiple charts.
colors.notes: Performance: positive #039649, neutral #ECEBEA, negative #E42513. Diverging listed is the Correlation pair with neutral grey (not an official ramp). Text colours tested to ≥4.5:1 on white. Guideline/crosshair lines stroke #7F7D7A 1px dash 1,1. Gridlines in anatomy images are light grey dotted (exact token not accessible).

axisTitle.placement: y title rotated (vertical-lr, reading bottom-to-top) at bottom-left of the label column; x title left-aligned below the first tick label; both grey #7F7D7A

typography.notes: All chart element text 14px / 18px line-height, weight 300 (light). Legend group heading weight 500; stacked legend value 16px/21px. Y-axis unit label (.mce-axis-y__unit) 14px #7F7D7A, displayed as a block. Numbers with thousands separators.

structure.gridlines: Horizontal only, light grey dotted lines across the plot (anatomy images); vertical none.
structure.axisLine: Solid dark x-axis baseline across the plot; matching solid black rule along the top of the plot, the y-label column and the legend column.
structure.ticks: Y ticks drawn as short solid lines (1px #7F7D7A border-top in CSS; dark in images) spanning the label column at each tick value, with the label right-aligned just below the line. No x tick marks.
structure.zeroLine: Bars/histograms need zero baseline; lines need not ('Focusing on the data is more important than showing the zero point').
structure.yAxisPlacement: left, in a separate column detached from the plot by a gap
structure.yAxisTitle: rotated, small grey, bottom-aligned at left edge of y-label column (e.g. 'Percent of GDP (%)', 'Price $')
structure.unitPlacement: In the axis title (e.g. '(%)', '$') or a separate y-axis unit element
structure.frame: No box; plot, y-label column and legend column each bounded by top and bottom black rules.
structure.notes: Built-in 3px gaps between adjacent plots (stacked bars, donut segments, adjacent bars). Benchmark marks are thick black horizontal bars over/near each bar.

legend.placement: right, in its own column aligned to the plot top under a black rule (vertical list); horizontal variant available with 12px item spacing
legend.directLabels: Line legends can show series name with latest value ('S&P 500 Return $5,374.80')
legend.title: optional group heading weight 500
legend.swatchShape: square for bars; short line segment for lines; ring (hollow circle) for donut
legend.notes: Items 14px light #1A1918, 6px vertical spacing, key 4px before label.

marks.bars: Flat fills, no rounding, separated by small white gaps (3px); categories may be sorted greatest→least; horizontal grey bands to align bars with labels when values are positive and negative. Benchmark shown as thick black bar segments.
marks.lines: ~2px straight line segments, no markers, never smoothed ('Don’t smooth out lines, since doing so may be misleading'). Don't show too many series.
marks.pies: Donut (thick ring, ~45% inner radius) built clockwise from the top in descending order starting with the largest; few segments, combine small ones into 'Other'; include annotations; white gaps between segments; no negative values.

labels.dataLabels: Static annotations (e.g. values above bars) can replace hover flags; must meet 4.5:1 contrast.

furniture.title: Product teams supply title/written description; a chart summary can be shown as on-screen text introducing the chart.
furniture.other: Benchmark elements, hover flags, pointers, crosshair guidelines are separate components.

annotations: Guidelines/crosshairs: 1px #7F7D7A dotted (dasharray 1,1). Static text annotations encouraged for accessibility.
layout: Chart = y-label column | plot | legend column, all sharing top/bottom rules; responsive design guidance exists (not read).
interaction: Hover flags (tooltips) and interactive legends are components; crosshair guidelines; screen zoom support; keyboard/screen-reader descriptions provided by product teams.
accessibility: Text ≥4.5:1 on white; 3px gaps between adjacent plots; pattern-fill support; table alternative for ≤20–30 rows, written description otherwise; don't rely on colour; simplify when >4–5 colours needed.

discouraged: donut with negative values or many small segments

distinctiveRules.rule: Y-axis tick labels sit in a separate left column, right-aligned directly beneath a short horizontal rule at each tick value (label hangs below the line).
All chart text is MorningstarIntrinsic 14px weight 300 (light), #1A1918; axis titles/units in grey #7F7D7A.
Y-axis title is rotated vertical text placed at the bottom of the y-label column; x-axis title left-aligned under the first category.
distinctiveRules.quote: Anatomy image: 'Percent of GDP (%)' rotated bottom-left; 'Sectors' under 'Technology'

distinctiveRules.rule: Horizontal dotted light-grey gridlines; solid dark rules at plot top and baseline; no vertical gridlines.
distinctiveRules.quote: Gridlines help read values accurately (anatomy shows dotted horizontals)

distinctiveRules.rule: Legend in a right-hand column starting under a top rule, vertical list; line-chart legend shows series name and current value.
distinctiveRules.quote: 'S&P 500 Return $5,374.80' under short blue line key

distinctiveRules.rule: Generic categorical colours must be used in fixed order: #2364B9, #B2013C, #F5C72C, #125B2F, #72A1E0, #6B4EA1, #F47206, #075F65, #039649, #E42513.
distinctiveRules.quote: Always use the generic colors in their provided order

distinctiveRules.rule: Semantic colours: Equity blue #2364B9, Fixed Income orange #F47206, Alternative crimson #B2013C, Cash green #039649, Other yellow #F5C72C, Not classified grey #ECEBEA; performance +#039649 / −#E42513.
3px white gaps between all adjacent plots (stacked segments, adjacent bars, donut slices).
distinctiveRules.quote: Chart Elements include built in 3px gaps between all adjacent plots

distinctiveRules.rule: Donuts start at 12 o'clock and run clockwise in descending order, largest first; merge small segments into 'Other'.
distinctiveRules.quote: Build clockwise from the top, in descending order starting with the largest category.

distinctiveRules.rule: Lines are never smoothed; zero baseline optional for lines but required for bars.
distinctiveRules.quote: Don’t smooth out lines ... you don’t always need to include a zero baseline

distinctiveRules.rule: Donut legend uses hollow ring markers; bar legend square swatches; line legend short line segments.
distinctiveRules.quote: Donut anatomy legend rings: Equities, Fixed Income, Real Estate, Cash, Commodities, Private Equity

distinctiveRules.rule: Use horizontal grey bands to align bars with labels when plotting positive and negative values; sort bars greatest→least when appropriate.
distinctiveRules.quote: Use horizontal gray bands to align bars with their corresponding y-axis labels

referenceImages.describes: Vertical bar anatomy (numbered callouts are doc annotations). Six flat Morningstar-blue (#2364B9) bars separated by thin white gaps, black thick benchmark dashes per category. Separate y-label column on the left: each value (0–100) right-aligned beneath a short solid black horizontal rule; rotated grey 'Percent of GDP (%)' at bottom-left. Plot bounded by solid black top rule and baseline; light grey dotted horizontal gridlines at 20/40/60/80. Condensed light sans (MorningstarIntrinsic) category labels below, grey 'Sectors' axis title left-aligned under the first label. Legend column right with top rule: blue square + 'Percent of U.S. GDP'. No title, no source.

Time-series line: single ~2px blue unsmoothed line, no markers. Same y-label column with values 0–6,000 hanging under short black rules, rotated grey 'Price $'. Dotted grey horizontal gridlines, black top rule and baseline; year labels 2020–2025 left-aligned at ticks, grey 'Year' below. Right legend column: short blue line key, 'S&P 500 Return' and '$5,374.80' value.

Thick donut with white gaps between segments, starting at 12 o'clock clockwise largest-first: blue Equities, orange Fixed Income, crimson Real Estate, green Cash, yellow Commodities, light grey Private Equity. Legend column to the right under a top rule with hollow ring markers and light condensed labels.
